_readme: Edit this file, then restart Clawd.
language: 'en' or 'ko'. Also on the right-click menu (언어/Language).
appearance.show_items: he holds up an icon matching what you're doing.
appearance.pixel_size / font_size / bubble_width scale him. They need a
full restart, not a reload.
focus.allowlist_mode: ONLY KLAS/Claude/PDF/Word/PowerPoint count as study.
Add your own with focus.allow_processes / focus.allow_title_words.
focus.hated / focus.hated_processes: sites and apps he reacts to ON SIGHT,
by name, skipping the polite tier — YouTube, Steam, TikTok and friends are
built in, and these lists add your own. stray.hated_seconds is how long he
waits first (0 = the moment the window settles).
focus.pardon_hours: double-click him on a window he is cross about, and if
the look says it really is coursework the anger comes off THAT window for
this long — which is how a lecture that lives on YouTube gets let off.
window_settle_seconds: a new window must hold still this long before he
reacts — stops a mid-load lecture page from setting him off.
api.max_line_chars: hard ceiling on a spoken line, cut at a sentence break.
schedule.json holds your timetable and deadlines — copy schedule.example.json
to start. Right-click -> 'today's briefing' shows it; 'edit schedule.json'
opens it. He re-reads the file whenever it changes, no restart needed.
deadline_horizon_days: how far ahead a deadline starts getting mentioned.
todo_poke_hours: how often he brings up a dated-less todo. 0-ish = often.
fireworks: the full-screen show, on the menu as 'fireworks!'. Its own
click-through window, so it never eats a click or moves Clawd.
seconds/bursts size the show; sound plays assets/firework_sound.mp3;
on_wake true fires the big one after wake_after_minutes instead of the
small sparkles over his head. enabled false hides the menu item too.
chatter: when he speaks unprompted on a window he is already watching.
base_interval_sec is the FIRST gap; each further line on the same window
multiplies it by growth, up to cap_sec. 300/1.6/1800 -> 5, 8, 13, 20, 30 min.
jitter 0.3 means every gap is randomly 0.7x-1.3x, so the rhythm cannot be
learned — this matters more than the decay does.
window_memory_sec: alt-tab away and back inside this and the count is kept.
silence_after_input_sec: no line while you are still typing.
recent_lines_buffer: how many lines back he refuses to repeat himself.
wake_after_minutes: no MOUSE movement for this long -> pixel fireworks.
api.enabled + an api key turn on screen reading, conversation and real quizzes.
No api_key here? Clawd asks for one in a box and stores it outside this folder,
or reads the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.
SCREENSHOTS ARE MANUAL, ALWAYS: DOUBLE-CLICK Clawd and he takes exactly one
look, decides study / stray / can't-tell, and reacts. He never captures the
screen on his own — there is no background watching in this build.
about_me is free text sent to the API as context. Empty = he knows nothing about you.
privacy.log_screen_details false keeps window titles and page topics out of clawd.log.
api.manual_delay_seconds is the pause before that capture. It is short:
his window never takes focus, so double-clicking him does not move you
off the window you were on. Raise it if you want time to switch.
api.check_timeout_seconds: if the answer has not come back by then he reacts
from the window title anyway, so a double-click never does nothing.

focus._readme: allowlist_mode true = ONLY these count as studying; everything else gets the angry treatment. false = the old keyword lists.
